description_en: Brutus wrote philosophical treatises and orations admired by Cicero and Seneca. All are now lost. Cicero's dialogue 'Brutus' (on the history of Roman oratory) features him prominently.

title_en: Praetorship and governance of Cisalpine Gaul
description_en: Brutus served as governor of Cisalpine Gaul (46–45 BCE) and urban praetor (44 BCE) under Caesar, demonstrating administrative competence.
Brutus issued the famous 'Eid Mar' denarius (RRC 508/3) featuring two daggers and a liberty cap, commemorating Caesar's assassination. Struck at a mobile military mint in the east, 43–42 BCE.
Brutus co-commanded the Republican forces at Philippi (42 BCE) with Cassius. He won the first engagement against Octavian but was defeated in the second battle.
